question: Which molecule consisted of Sulphur atom with double bond?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id
FROM AtomDetails AS T1
INNER JOIN AtomMolecule AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
INNER JOIN connected AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
INNER JOIN bond AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 's'
  AND T4.bond_type = '='
  AND T2.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id
